body.heading: Where in the world is Central African Republic?
paragraphs: Central African Republic is a country in Middle Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Central African Republic is Bangui.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Central African Republic speak Sango and French.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Central African Republic is the Central African CFA franc. The CFA franc is shared with neighbouring countries, so the same money works across the region.

body.heading: How big is Central African Republic?
paragraphs: Central African Republic covers about 623,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Angola.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: In the Dzanga-Sangha rainforest, forest elephants gather at a famous muddy clearing called Dzanga Bai, and trackers can help families spot lowland gorillas.
Near the capital Bangui, the Boali Falls crash over wide rock steps on the Mbali River, surrounded by green hills and picnic spots.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Central African Republic on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
